invariants: Python task state remains the sole semantic owner of task phase, disposition, required command, retry, blocker, and completion decisions.

Every authoritative v2 projection preserves version, authoritative, taskSessionId, epoch, fingerprint, routeHash, planRevision, activeSliceId, mutationGeneration, disposition, and exact required command identity.
Invalid or incomplete task-owned v2 control never falls back to legacy routing.
Every recoverable running state has an executable path to COMPLETE, AWAITING_USER_INPUT, CANCELLED, or a truthful terminal state.
A producer may exceed an in-memory window only when the durable state records total count, cursor, overflow, complete-set digest, and a lossless continuation mechanism.
Per-phase budgets reset only at a committed compatible phase boundary; lifetime counters remain diagnostic and do not consume the next phase budget.
Synthesis readiness requires the exact prompt-bound bundle to materialize all required representative pairs or explicitly marks coverage incomplete.

The existing mutation journal, authorization, CAS, static validation, build proof, automation, and rollback data plane remains unchanged unless a failing regression test proves an integration adjustment is required.
UI delivery is documented and implemented as recoverable at-most-once intent with explicit operator confirmation or explicit duplicate-risk re-emission, never as unprovable exactly-once delivery.

Installation is transactional and runtime identities bind all production dependencies; FULL installation ends in Agent authority and pins unreal-rag, unreal-agent, evidence-first, and unreal-context-compactor without running GUI/model E2E.
